description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of various models on a classification task, with the vertical axis representing accuracy ranging from 40% to 65% in 5% increments and the horizontal axis displaying five different models. The models compared are RoBERTa w/o Exp. (light gray), ExEnt (light blue), LaSQuE (mean) (orange), LaSQuE (green), and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) (dark gray). The RoBERTa w/o Exp. model achieves an accuracy of approximately 46%. ExEnt shows a higher accuracy of about 55%. The LaSQuE (mean) model has an accuracy of around 47%, while the LaSQuE (green) model reaches approximately 48%. The LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) model demonstrates the highest performance, with an accuracy of about 62%. The chart visually emphasizes that the LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) model significantly outperforms the others, highlighting the effectiveness of incorporating quantifier modeling and curriculum learning.
